# Pleats (`pleats`)

A macro of pleated paper, satin or linen under a raking light, or a lantern glowing at dusk.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: sun, location
- Cost: medium (~4.5 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Pleats, Graphite Satin, Paper Lantern

## Params

| `pleats` | Pleats | slider | 20 … 120 (step 1) | 32 |
| `depth` | Depth | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.7 |
| `breathe` | Breathe | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `material` | Material | menu | 0 Paper · 1 Satin · 2 Linen · 3 Lantern | 0 (Paper) |
| `light` | Light Angle | slider | -90 … 90 | -35 |
| `focus` | Depth of Field | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
| `live` | Follow the Sun | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
